title: Parade drummers and the Matthews brothers
summary: Societies' parades were tied to bands: Foster with Tuxedo, Williams, Cottrell; he thinks Bebe Matthews was the best of the Matthews brothers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you remember any others on parade that you used to like? Especially?
If you'd follow on parade that you used to like?

I knew another left hand drummer in Chicago, Snaggs Jones. He left here very early though. Uh huh. Played with King Oliver, now way back. Oh yeah. He was left handed. Um, we were talking about some of your favorite drummers. Do you remember any others on parade that you used to like? Especially? If you'd follow on a parade?

Yeah, but most likely, under these fellas used to play, the parades could look like their band had the job, contract with the societies. That was the time, yeah. And most likely all the time it would be Charney would be with the Tuxedo band, and Alfred Williams, and Contra was with parades for last month. And the Bay was with the Hornwood band. Oh yeah. And all that sort of thing. I could remember that.
Do you remember the other Matthews brothers that played?

Yeah, I remember Bill when he played drums. He was a good drummer too. I heard he won the parade too. In late years he played one parade once. Yeah, he was a good drummer. Yeah. He was a good drummer. He was a good drummer.
Yeah. He was a good drummer. Yeah. He was a good drummer. Yeah. Yeah.
Which one do you think was the best drummer?
I think that Bebe was the best drummer.
The best drummer in the family. I think, yeah.
Because I heard him play in the string band and everything like that, you know.
In the parades what did Bebe play? A snare drum? A snare drum.
